newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 25.28 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 25.28 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Yemen said on Wednesday its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average 25.28 percent, down from the average 26.21 percent at the September 4 auction for 91-day bills.
Of the two billion rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 1.9 billion rials.
The average price was 9,406.99 rials and the lowest price accepted was 9,383. Yields ranged from 21.11 percent to 26.38 percent.
The latest issue of 182-day bills yielded an average 26.67 percent, up from last month's average 23.56 percent.
Of the one billion rials worth of 182-day bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 874.78 million rials.
The average price was 8,826.32 rials and the lowest price was 8,657.38. Yields ranged from 23.08 percent to 31.10 percent.
The Bank said the next auction would be held on November 9.
